story: At 11:17 on a mild, partly cloudy Thursday morning in Sumter Oaks, Gary is focused on mounting a speaker bracket to his golf cart frame, though the cart sits unpowered while he waits for approval. Donna, looking determined, is heading over to Gary's House, while Hal and Rosa chat contentedly and warmly on Magnolia Loop about Saturday's dinner at six. Hal promises a pie made from the commissary lady's recipe, and Rosa happily confirms the table is set for four, with Gary still hoping to be pinned down for the invitation.
events: Gary (gary golf cart): Mount the speaker bracket on the cart frame, unpowered, waiting on approval

gary.thought_process: I filed the Architectural Review form back at tick 35, so I'm not breaking L-01 by working on the cart, and I've kept everything unpowered per Hal's advice. The light strips are on the frame and the amp wiring is bench-tested and labeled. Next step is mounting the speaker hardware on the cart, but I'll hold off on powering anything until approval comes through. Plus L-03 means any sound testing has to stay well inside daytime hours, and it's late morning, so a quiet fit check is fine. I'll mount the speaker bracket on the cart frame and leave it unplugged.

parameters.content: Mount the speaker bracket on the cart frame, unpowered, waiting on approval

donna.thought_process: Rosa asked me to nudge Gary her way if I see him, and I already asked her about dessert and the guest list last tick, so no need to repeat that. Gary keeps slipping past everyone, and I still need to pin him down for Saturday pickleball. His house is on Magnolia Loop. Hal is watching the street, but my flamingos are already trimmed to three, so there's no fight there. Best move now is to head to Gary's house, catch him, and get him on the court as my partner.

parameters.content: Heading over to Gary's to pin him down about Saturday pickleball and Rosa's dinner.

hal.thought_process: I'm back on Magnolia Loop with Donna and Rosa in sight. My notebook already says the flamingos are at three, so no complaint there, and I'm not going to nag a woman who cooperated. Rosa's Saturday dinner at six is the thing I've been looking forward to, and she hasn't had a straight answer from me on what I'm bringing. Better to settle that now than let her ask twice. Gary's filing can wait until he actually files.

parameters.content: Morning, Rosa. About Saturday at six, I'll bring a pie from the commissary lady's recipe, and I'll be on time. Anything else you need hauled over?

rosa.thought_process: Donna asked two things: can she bring dessert, and is Gary still on the list. I already asked her to nudge Gary, so I shouldn't repeat that. Answer her directly: dessert is a yes, Gary is absolutely still invited. Hal just arrived too, but he's already confirmed, so Donna's question comes first. Then I can go hunt down Gary next tick.

parameters.content: Dessert is a yes, Donna, bless you. And Gary's absolutely still on the list, I just have to catch him standing still long enough to say so. Saturday at six, table's set for four.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
